blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Wednesday said that the General Appropriations Acts (GAAs) for 2024 and 2025 will go down in history as the worst budgets approved by Congress. The remark was made after the Supreme Court (SC) ruled on Tuesday that some provisions in the 2024 and 2025 GAAs were unconstitutional. “The 2024 and 2025 GAAs will go down in history as the worst budgets ever passed by Congress,” Lacson said in a statement.
